page.content:
Middle enclosure — the world of humans.

How Midgard connects

  • Location: Yggdrasil — Midgard hangs on Yggdrasil as the human enclosure.
  • Character: Jormungandr — Jormungandr encircles Midgard in the outer ocean.

What is Midgard?

Midgard is the human world, girdled by the ocean where Jormungandr lies. The gods built it from the body of Ymir and set it under Asgard's watch.

Key threads lead to Yggdrasil and Jormungandr.
